description: Where a ship is right now: in port (and when it leaves), at sea between two ports (how far across, next arrival), or between sailings, with the stops coming up, approximate coordinates, and links to its tracker map and sailing. Estimated from the sailing's schedule and charted route, not a live GPS or AIS feed: exact at each port call, estimated between ports. Times are port local time.

ship.description: Ship name, e.g. "Icon of the Seas"
